orgId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal character string that identifies the organization the resource belongs to.

resourceId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal character string that identifies the non-compliant resource.

resourceName.description: Unique human readable string that identifies the non-compliant resource.

resourcePoliciesCausingNonCompliance.description: List of resource policies causing the resource to be considered non-compliant.

resourceType.description: Human-readable label that displays the type of a resource.

policyId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal character string that identifies the policy.

policiesCausingNonCompliance.description: List of policies that are in conflict with the current state of the resource.

resourcePolicyId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal character string that identifies the atlas resource policy.

resourcePolicyName.description: Human-readable label that describes the atlas resource policy.
